# Memory matching challenge

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/memory-game/

Match pairs of symbols in a timed card game with adjustable difficulty. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Choose a 4 × 4 board, reveal two cards at a time and try to finish with fewer moves.

## Limits and checks

This is entertainment and practice. It does not measure intelligence, diagnose memory problems or provide a clinical cognitive score.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
